messages.content: Alice: I paid for our train tickets to the mountains: €180 total. Split equally among all three of us.
Bob: The scenery from the train is absolutely breathtaking!
Charlie: I got snacks for the journey: €36. Shared between Bob and me.
Alice: I can't believe how clear the mountain air is up here.
Bob: Lunch at the station cafe cost €75. Split 3 ways.
Charlie: My phone battery is already down to 50% from all the photos.
Alice: Museum entrance fees were €45 total for all three of us.
Bob: This museum has an incredible collection of local artifacts.
Charlie: I bought souvenirs for €60. Split equally.
Alice: The guided tour starts in 15 minutes, we should head over.
Bob: Taxi to the hotel was €30. Split equally.
Charlie: Our hotel room has an amazing view of the valley.
Alice: Dinner at the restaurant cost €120. Shared among all three.
Bob: I'm exhausted after today's travel, but it was worth it.
Charlie: Groceries for breakfast tomorrow: €27. Split between Alice and me.
Alice: The sunset over the mountains is absolutely stunning.
Bob: I paid for the cable car tickets: €45 total for all of us.
Charlie: The view from the cable car is even better than I imagined.
Alice: Coffee break cost €21. Shared equally.
Bob: I think I left my water bottle on the cable car.
Charlie: Lunch at the mountain restaurant: €90. Split 3 ways.
Alice: The hiking trail looks challenging but rewarding.
Bob: I got rain jackets for everyone: €75 total. Shared equally.
Charlie: Good thing we got those jackets - looks like rain is coming.
Alice: Snacks for the hike: €18. Bob and Charlie owe me.
Bob: The trail is getting steeper but the views are incredible.
Charlie: Emergency first aid kit: €33. Split among all three.
Alice: We're almost at the summit, just a bit further!
Bob: Water and energy drinks: €24. Shared equally.
Charlie: I can see the entire valley from up here - amazing!
Alice: Got a €12 refund on the museum tickets for Bob and me.
Bob: The descent is much easier than the climb up.
Charlie: Dinner back at the hotel: €105. Split 3 ways.
Alice: My legs are going to be sore tomorrow.
Bob: Taxi to the hot springs: €36. Shared equally.
Charlie: The hot springs are so relaxing after that hike.
Alice: Entrance to hot springs: €39 total for all three.
Bob: I could stay in these hot springs all night.
Charlie: Towel rental: €15. Split between Alice and me.
Alice: The stars are so clear out here away from the city lights.
Bob: Late night snacks: €27. Shared equally.
Charlie: I'm getting sleepy after the hot springs.
Alice: Breakfast at the hotel: €48. Split 3 ways.
Bob: My legs are definitely sore today.
Charlie: Souvenir photos: €30. Split equally.
Alice: The local market looks interesting, let's check it out.
Bob: Local crafts shopping: €90. Shared among all three.
Charlie: These handmade souvenirs are beautiful.
Alice: Lunch at the market: €63. Split equally.
Bob: I'm getting hungry again already.
